description: This file defines the AlertsController class for managing alert notifications within the SuiteCRM system, including actions to get, add, mark as read, and redirect alerts.

classes.name: AlertsController
classes.description: Controller class handling alert-related actions such as retrieving, adding, marking as read, and redirecting alerts.

methods.name: action_get
methods.description: Retrieves unread alerts for the current user and sets view variables.

methods.name: action_add
methods.description: Adds a new alert or reminder, possibly showing a popup if a reminder is created.

methods.name: action_markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific alert as read.

methods.name: action_redirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to the alert's URL and marks the alert as read.
